notes: Status 'qualified' is set only by the exact-SHA release qualification. Suites refer to validation/release-plan.json.

requirements.title: Python-first implementation
requirements.notes: Python package skeleton (ionmc) with provenance/CLI in V2-001; transport physics follows.

requirements.title: Reference Python execution
requirements.notes: Reference Python backend (float64, shared step physics) in V2-004.

requirements.title: NVIDIA Warp acceleration
requirements.notes: Warp CPU and CUDA backends executing the shared step physics (V2-005); optimization pending.

requirements.title: Ion transport
requirements.notes: Electromagnetic transport of any ionmc species on the reference backend (V2-004); nuclear physics pending.

requirements.title: Homogeneous reference geometries
requirements.notes: Homogeneous boxes via homogeneous_box (V2-004).

requirements.title: Voxelized geometries
requirements.notes: Voxel geometry with per-voxel material index and density (V2-004).

requirements.title: Material assignment
requirements.notes: Material/density assignment per voxel, slab phantoms (V2-004).

requirements.title: Changeable scoring grids
requirements.notes: Scoring grids of different resolution/alignment with path-length-weighted deposit and overlap masses (V2-004).

requirements.title: Absorbed dose
requirements.notes: Dose per primary (Gy) on the scoring grid (V2-004).

requirements.title: Energy deposition
requirements.notes: Energy deposition per primary with escape/cutoff accounting (V2-004).

requirements.title: Analytical physics layer
requirements.notes: Analytic Bethe layer with corrections (ionmc.physics.stopping), validated vs ICRU 90/PSTAR/ASTAR (V2-003).

requirements.title: External/tabulated data layer
requirements.notes: Tabulated layer: shipped ICRU 90 water tables and NIST PSTAR/ASTAR acquisition (V2-003).

requirements.title: Separation of transport from data source
requirements.notes: Transport consumes packed tables only (TableSet); sources are recorded in provenance (V2-004).

requirements.title: No large physics datasets in Git
requirements.notes: Only an 8 kB ICRU 90 key-data table is shipped; NIST tables are cached outside Git (V2-003).

requirements.title: Automatic acquisition
requirements.notes: Automatic NIST STAR acquisition through the provenance cache and `ionmc data fetch` (V2-003).

requirements.title: Local caching
requirements.notes: Content-addressed local cache with configurable location (V2-003).

requirements.title: Dataset versioning
requirements.notes: Dataset records carry dataset_id/version identifiers (V2-003).

requirements.title: Integrity verification
requirements.notes: SHA-256 verification on fetch and reuse; pinned hashes supported (V2-003).

requirements.title: Provenance
requirements.notes: Provenance records exist for datasets and tables; result persistence follows.

requirements.title: Offline reuse
requirements.notes: Offline reuse via IONMC_OFFLINE/--offline; missing data raises actionable errors (V2-003).

requirements.title: Explicit random control
requirements.notes: Explicit seed; batch streams via SeedSequence (reference backend) (V2-004).

requirements.title: Parallel-safe random streams
requirements.notes: Counter-based per-history Warp streams; numpy SeedSequence batches (V2-005).

requirements.title: Cross-backend statistical consistency
requirements.notes: Statistical parity criterion (decision 0042) with CPU evidence; CUDA evidence through host-runner tests (V2-005).

requirements.title: Statistical uncertainty estimation
requirements.notes: Batch-based standard error, NaN when undefined (V2-004).

requirements.title: High-throughput execution
requirements.notes: First EM-only timings recorded; targets evaluated after full physics (V2-005).

requirements.title: GPU-oriented architecture
requirements.notes: Whole-history device loop, no per-step host control (V2-005).

requirements.title: Reproducible benchmarking
requirements.notes: Calibration measured and numeric targets frozen in V2-002 (decision 0039); measurements against targets follow implementation.

requirements.title: Explicit physical units
requirements.notes: Units documented in APIs, results and summaries (mm, MeV/u, Gy per primary) (V2-004).

requirements.title: Coordinate-system documentation
requirements.notes: Coordinate convention documented in geometry and persisted with results (V2-004).

requirements.title: Backend consistency
requirements.notes: Python vs Warp CPU vs Warp CUDA parity tests (V2-005); repeated at each physics addition.

requirements.title: Automated testing
requirements.notes: Package test layout, locked CI environment and pre-commit coverage established in V2-001; scientific tests follow.

requirements.title: CI integration
requirements.notes: Package test layout, locked CI environment and pre-commit coverage established in V2-001; scientific tests follow.

requirements.title: Pre-commit framework
requirements.notes: Package test layout, locked CI environment and pre-commit coverage established in V2-001; scientific tests follow.

requirements.title: fail-closed capability contract
requirements.notes: Fail-closed capability contract with discoverable capabilities() and discriminating tests (V2-004); more flags with later physics.

requirements.title: adversarial numerical falsification
requirements.notes: Step-size, grid shift/coarsening and energy-balance probes in tests (V2-004).

requirements.title: physical evidence lineage and sufficiency
requirements.notes: First evidence lineage records: PSTAR/ASTAR (evaluation), ICRU 90 addendum (construction/evaluation split by energy window) (V2-003).

requirements.title: self-describing persisted scientific results
requirements.notes: Self-describing npz+json results reopened in a clean process; text summary (V2-004); influence and remaining fields later.

requirements.title: complete clean-install scientific workflow
requirements.notes: ionmc run with JSON configuration, offline reuse (V2-004).

requirements.title: frozen application-level performance/resource gates
requirements.notes: Calibration measured and numeric targets frozen in V2-002 (decision 0039); measurements against targets follow implementation.

requirements.title: complete qualification and promotion
requirements.notes: Release plan with 18 suites and acceptance criteria frozen in V2-002.
